title: Mila and Pip's Fruit Fun
markdown:
The sleepy sun peeked over the hills, painting the sky with soft rose. Mila, with her curious eyes, and Pip the duck, soft as a cloud, were ready for a new day. “Let’s visit Gran Ada at her fruit stand,” Mila whispered, her voice like a lullaby. Pip gave a happy quack and waddled along.

Gran Ada’s stand was a rainbow of colours: plump strawberries, golden oranges, and juicy apples, all sitting as if they hoped to be chosen. “Good morning, my little explorers!” Gran Ada greeted them, her voice warm like cocoa. “What adventure brings you here?”

“We want to know which fruit is everyone’s favourite!” Mila explained. “What most people choose.” She had her notepad and pencil ready. Pip nodded, making a contented quack-quack.

“Let’s help Gran Ada know,” Gran Ada said, her eyes twinkling. “We’ll make a little mark for each fruit your friends choose.”

Soon, Leo ambled over. “An apple, please!” Mila drew a neat line next to Apples. Pip watched with a soft quack. Then Lily arrived. “Oh, I adore strawberries!” Mila drew a line next to Strawberries.

More friends came, their voices a gentle murmur. Some wanted oranges, and Mila drew lines. Others chose apples again. Pip nudged Mila’s hand with his soft beak, as if to say, look at the marks growing.

As the morning moved along, Mila looked at her paper. The lines had grown like a quiet garden. Apples had four lines. Strawberries also had four lines. Oranges had three lines. It was a close race.

“Oh, look, Gran Ada!” Mila whispered. “Apples and strawberries are tied for favourite! Most friends chose those!”

Gran Ada smiled warmly. “See, my dear? By making those marks, you’ve discovered what your friends enjoy most!”

Pip puffed out his chest with a proud quack.

“So,” Mila said softly, “when we make a mark for each thing we see, and then count those marks, we can easily see which one there is the most of. It’s called a tally, and it helps us know what lots of people like.”

Gran Ada nodded. “That’s exactly right, my clever explorer. A simple tally. And for your wonderful discovery, a yummy piece of your favourite fruit?”

Mila chose a bright strawberry, and Pip nibbled a juicy orange slice. The gentle breeze whispered. The sun felt warm and peaceful. Mila tucked away her notepad, feeling content. Pip snuggled close. They had learned something new. As they headed home, Mila hummed a happy tune, and Pip gave a soft sleepy quack. She wondered what other simple secrets the world held, just waiting to be counted and understood.
characters: Mila (curious builder), Pip (cloud-soft duck), Ada (cocoa-warm gran)
